illustration_style: Original festive adult colouring-book illustration in expressive black fineliner, combining cosy architectural storytelling with decorative seasonal pattern work.
line_weight: Fine-to-medium variable black outlines, with slightly heavier outer contours and foreground framing elements.
line_quality: Clean, confident hand-inked contours; gently imperfect organic curves; precise architectural marks; controlled short hatching.
detail_level: High but colourable detail: layered environmental motifs, architectural trims and small festive accents balanced with generous enclosed areas for pencils and pens.
character_language: Stylised storybook figures, if included, with simple readable silhouettes, warm restrained expressions and uncluttered facial features.
background_density: Richly detailed, deep-view backgrounds built in receding layers; distant elements simplify to preserve clear focal areas.
composition: Framed-viewpoint compositions with a strong visual threshold, clear focal hierarchy, layered depth and deliberate breathing room within major colourable shapes.
palette: Monochrome artwork only; line design should support a colourist’s own winter-night palette of deep blue, evergreen, berry red, warm gold and soft ivory.
shading: Minimal contour-following hatching, sparse stippling and selective black fills to imply night-time contrast without pre-colouring or muddying the page.
texture: Crisp uncoated-paper ink feel, with patterned surface details expressed through simple repeatable marks rather than grey tonal rendering.
mood: Magical, intimate, nostalgic and quietly festive.
print_considerations: Pure black linework on white, no grey wash or full-bleed black areas; maintain strong contrast and open colourable sections for reliable home printing on A4 or US Letter. Keep essential artwork safely inset from trim edges and avoid overly fragile micro-detail.
shared_prompt: Original adult Christmas colouring-book art in expressive black fineliner on clean white paper: confident variable-weight contours, crisp hand-inked architectural detail, gentle organic curves, high but colourable patterned detail, spacious enclosed shapes, sparse contour hatching and stippling, selective black accents, deep layered storytelling, magical intimate winter-night mood, monochrome only, home-print-friendly.
avoid: Any copyrighted characters, logos, brand imagery or recognisable existing colouring-book compositions
Photorealism, painterly greyscale rendering, colour fills or watercolour effects
Overcrowded micro-detail, muddy tonal shading or large solid-black ink areas
Thin broken outlines, inconsistent perspective or illegible architectural forms
Misspelled text, decorative pseudo-text or unreliable generated lettering
Childish cartoon styling, exaggerated kawaii features or overly cutesy expressions
